org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model

Class PhasingConstants

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model.PhasingConstants

  • public class PhasingConstants
extends Object
    Constants data class containing phasing constants. This class is populated from database data in the Constant class and is made available to executors and the user interface controllers in the ConstantsCache.
